channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Naga, Sobhita celebrate first anniversary; dreamy wedding video, romantic posts
item.description: Sobhita Dhulipala and Naga Chaitanya are celebrating their first wedding anniversary, and to mark the special day, she shared a beautiful wedding video, revisiting precious moments and traditional rituals from their December 2024 ceremony. She also penned a heartfelt poem and proudly called herself one year of being Mrs. Naga Chaitanya.

item.title: Nothing opens $5 million community investment round at unchanged $1.3B valuation
item.description: London-based tech firm Nothing is opening a $5 million community investment round at its existing $1.3 billion valuation, giving retail investors another entry point before a possible IPO.

item.title: IndiGo's frontline staff bear the fallout of leadership's FDTL miscalculation, lax approach
item.description: As IndiGo scrambles to contain nationwide flight disruptions, employees say the real failure lies in leadership's poor preparedness for new duty-time norms despite two years of headstart.

item.title: Domestic investors pour $81.3 billion into Indian markets in 2025 to date
item.description: The report from brokerage Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL) said that the earnings of companies it tracked grew 12 per cent year‑on‑year in the Q2 FY26, while Nifty earnings rose 2 per cent, marking a sixth straight quarter of single‑digit profit after tax (PAT) growth.

item.title: India's smartphone exports to US jump over 300 pc in October
item.description: According to the data, smartphone exports to the United States have seen a sharp rebound this fiscal, touching $10.78 billion during the April–October period, up from $3.60 billion in the same period last year.

item.title: K'taka Upalokayukta flags 'rampant' 63 pc corruption in state; BJP demands CM, DCM's resignation
item.description: The Upalokayukta's claim that corruption in Karnataka stands at 63 per cent has put the state government on the defensive, while the Bharatiya Janata Party has sharply attacked Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar, demanding their resignation in the wake of the revelation.

item.title: Chaos continues at Hyderabad Airport, 74 flights cancelled
item.description: For the third consecutive day, the airline cancelled several flights, causing severe inconvenience to thousands of passengers. A total of 74 IndiGo flights have been cancelled for the day, an airport spokesman said. These include 37 arrivals and 37 departures.

item.title: Apple rolls out hypertension alerts in India; over 1 million users expected to benefit
item.description: Apple has begun rolling out hypertension notifications for Apple Watch users in India, a major health update first announced at the iPhone 17 launch and now available on select models.

item.title: Ranveer Singh Dhurandhar row: Yami Gautam exposes 'paid negative PR', Hrithik Roshan voices support
item.description: A day before the release of Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar, his wife, actress Yami Gautam, took to social media to share a lengthy note about ending the trend of creating hype. She criticised the negative paid media culture and highlighted how Dhurandhar is facing the concept of cancel culture even before its release. Echoing her views, her Kaabil co-star Hrithik Roshan also responded.

item.title: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrives on two-day State Visit, received by PM Modi at airport
item.description: The two leaders warmly hugged and greeted each other at the tarmac before leaving the airport together in the same vehicle.
